provenance.native_catalog: The existing generated catalog is retained as one source-level data owner. Ordinary initialized definitions emit its complete original contiguous data run in source order in all three regions. This reconstruction treats the homogeneous catalog as a legitimate data-only translation unit; no stronger claim about original filenames is made. Every object address, physical extent, initializer and relocation target is preserved; no padding, qualification or regional-bound changes are introduced.
